note: Staff questionnaire for the new commercial LOS. Each role gets its own survey: the questions whose 'roles' list includes that role, in section order. Question IDs (Q##) are stable and never reused; they are the key used to match answers that come back from Microsoft Forms.
intro: We are choosing the bank's next commercial loan system, which has to be live before the current contract ends in March 2029. Before we look at any vendor, we want to hear from the people who use the system every day: what works, what gets in the way, and what matters most. This survey is anonymous and takes about 15 to 20 minutes. There are no right answers; rough estimates are fine.
closing: Thank you. Your answers go straight into the requirements and the vendor demo scripts. We will share a summary of what we heard, by team, once the survey closes.

roles.label: Credit Analysts
roles.intro: Analysts spend the most time inside the credit side of the system. We want to know where spreading, memos, risk rating and annual reviews take more effort than they should.

roles.label: Credit Review
roles.intro: Loan review depends on finding the full credit story quickly. We want to know how easy it is today to sample loans, check grades, track findings and support exams.

roles.label: Credit Management
roles.intro: You see the whole credit process and answer for it to the board and examiners. We want your view of the workflow, approval authority, reporting and your team's capacity for change.

roles.label: Lending Officers
roles.intro: Lenders are the bank's link to the borrower. We want to know where the system helps or slows you down, from first conversation to closing, in the office and on the road.

roles.label: Portfolio Managers
roles.intro: Portfolio managers keep existing relationships healthy. We want to know how well the system supports renewals, annual reviews, covenants, maturities and the watch list.

roles.label: Lending Management
roles.intro: You manage the lending teams and the pipeline. We want your view of turnaround times, reporting, staffing and what the bank should prioritize in a new system.

roles.label: Commercial Lending Assistants
roles.intro: Commercial lending assistants touch nearly every loan between approval and boarding. We want to know where documents, closing and data entry take the most effort.

roles.label: Commercial Lending Assistant Management
roles.intro: You manage the people who move loans from approval to the core system. We want your view of workload, errors, handoffs and how ready your team is for a change.
